create.name: Renée Trudeau
create.bio:
Renée Trudeau (also published as Renee Peterson Trudeau) leads self-renewal retreats for women and writes about self-care as a spiritual practice. The eldest of seven, she spent part of her childhood in the Sierra Nevada after her parents left city life for a simpler one, and she worked for years in communications and career coaching before the deaths of both parents and a brother in close succession turned her towards this work. She has studied yoga, insight meditation and conscious movement with many teachers and has been coaching since 1990.

In 2002 she began Personal Renewal Groups, monthly circles where mothers met to practise looking after themselves; the model spread abroad, and her team went on to certify several hundred facilitators. Her books, The Mother's Guide to Self-Renewal and Nurturing the Soul of Your Family, grew from that work. She has presented at Kripalu since 2008 and at other large retreat centres, and her weekends mix rest, yoga nidra, journaling, song and nature-based ritual. She also offers recorded virtual retreats, an online course for women who want to lead their own circles, and pilgrimages to Iona. She divides her time between Austin and the mountains of western North Carolina, where she runs a weekly community dance class.

books.title: The Mother's Guide to Self-Renewal: How to Reclaim, Rejuvenate and Re-Balance Your Life
books.author: Renee Peterson Trudeau
books.description: Renée's first book, arranged as a year of monthly themes, each a small at-home retreat with stories, photographs and reflective exercises. It is written for mothers who have lost touch with their own needs and want gentle ways back.

books.title: Nurturing the Soul of Your Family: 10 Ways to Reconnect and Find Peace in Everyday Life
books.author: Renee Peterson Trudeau
books.description: Part memoir and part guide, published by New World Library, on bringing more calm and connection into ordinary family life. Ten chapters offer practices for slowing down, simplifying and tending one's own inner life as a parent.

courses.title: Permission Granted: A Women's Self-Renewal Retreat
courses.description: A weekend for women at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, on rest, intuition and the sacred feminine. Days combine ritual, song and free movement with nature-based writing, stillness and yoga nidra.

courses.title: Sinking into Stillness: A Winter Solstice Retreat
courses.description: A live two-and-a-half-hour retreat on Zoom for the winter solstice, with meditation, poetry, song and a long yoga nidra. A recording is shared afterwards for those who register.

courses.title: Sing, Dance, Pray: Iona Pilgrimage & Retreat with Renee Trudeau
courses.description: A week-long pilgrimage for a small group of women on the Scottish island of Iona. The days bring together slow island walking, song circles in the abbey, Celtic stories of Brigid, meditation and reflection on what each person is called to do.

courses.title: Secrets to Facilitating Life-Changing Groups & Retreats with Renee Trudeau
courses.description: A self-paced video course for women who want to lead circles or retreats in their own area, drawn from the facilitator training Renée ran for eighteen years. It comes with a recorded mentoring session, a written facilitator guide, her two books as ebooks and a recorded retreat.

courses.title: STILL, DARK & QUIET: A Deep Rest Retreat
courses.description: A recorded mini retreat of about two and a half hours, built around rest in the dark months. It can be downloaded and followed at home at any time.

courses.title: SOVEREIGNTY: A Women's Self-Renewal Retreat
courses.description: A three-hour guided retreat recorded with a group of women, on standing in one's own truth and power. It includes a yoga nidra session and is available to download.

courses.title: Embracing the Wild Unknown: Nurturing Yourself in Midlife & Beyond
courses.description: A pre-recorded audio course for women in their forties, fifties and beyond who are between chapters of life. Renée guides listeners to accept where they are and listen for what they long for next.

free_resources.title: Finding Your Center Meditation with Renee Trudeau
free_resources.description: A guided meditation of under six minutes on YouTube for settling attention and coming back to yourself in the middle of a busy day.

free_resources.title: Pause. Breathe. A 3 Minute Meditation.
free_resources.description: A short breathing pause led by Renée, meant to be used whenever you need to stop and reset for a few minutes.
